nodes.label: HttpServer
nodes.desc: Server builder: keeps bind addresses, keep-alive/timeouts and the app factory; run() L1407 starts one worker thread per core, each instantiating the factory.

nodes.label: H1Service
nodes.desc: HTTP/1.1 protocol service; ServiceFactory impl at L444 converts an accepted socket into a Dispatcher wired to the app service.

nodes.label: Dispatcher
nodes.desc: Per-connection state machine that drives the whole read-decode-call-write cycle for HTTP/1.x, including queued requests and keep-alive.

nodes.label: Codec
nodes.desc: Framed codec: parses raw bytes into Request messages and encodes Responses back onto the write buffer.

nodes.label: Dispatcher::read_available
nodes.desc: L1310: drains the socket into the read buffer until it would block, feeding the decoder.

nodes.label: Dispatcher::poll_request
nodes.desc: L1029: decodes every complete request in the buffer but stops at the 16-request queue cap (L42).

nodes.label: Dispatcher::handle_request
nodes.desc: L944: for each decoded request, resolves EXPECT 100-continue via the expect handler, then calls the service and eagerly polls it once.

nodes.label: Dispatcher::poll_response
nodes.desc: L687: the core loop - pops queued messages, keeps one service call in flight, streams response payload chunks into the write buffer.

nodes.label: Payload
nodes.desc: L33: sender/receiver pair created per bodied request; the dispatcher sinks chunks, extractors consume them as a stream.

nodes.label: App
nodes.desc: Builder (App::new L40) collecting app_data, services, default service and middleware; service() L243 registers HttpServiceFactory items.

nodes.label: AppEntry
nodes.desc: L372: the App's ServiceFactory face. new_service invokes the app factory so each worker gets its own resolved AppRouting.

nodes.label: AppRoutingFactory
nodes.desc: L281: resolves every registered resource factory concurrently (join_all L303) into the ready router.

nodes.label: AppInitService
nodes.desc: L230-269: call() reuses pooled HttpRequest objects (pool pop at L245), updates path/head, then emits a ServiceRequest into the router.

nodes.label: AppRouting
nodes.desc: L337: holds the recognized Router plus default service; call() L349 runs recognize_fn, verifies the resource path match, and dispatches.

nodes.label: Resource
nodes.desc: L51: one path pattern (ResourceDef) with routes, guards and a default; registered via HttpServiceFactory at L409.

nodes.label: ResourceFactory
nodes.desc: L519: builds all route services concurrently during app initialization.

nodes.label: ResourceService
nodes.desc: L551: call() L563 linear-scans routes; the first RouteService whose guards pass takes the request, else the default service.

nodes.label: ResourceEndpoint
nodes.desc: L575: one endpoint per resource stored in the Router so recognize_fn can find the right factory.

nodes.label: Route
nodes.desc: L23: method/guard list plus handler; method() L161 and guard() L182 push predicates, to() L245 attaches the handler.

nodes.label: RouteService
nodes.desc: L114: check() L122 evaluates guards against GuardContext; call() L141 forwards to the boxed inner service.

nodes.label: Guard
nodes.desc: L137: check(&GuardContext) -> bool predicates - Method, Header, Host, Acceptable - applied before any handler runs.

nodes.label: handler_service
nodes.desc: L96: fn_service wrapper created by Route::to; splits ServiceRequest, runs extraction, invokes the handler, wraps output as ServiceResponse.

nodes.label: Handler trait
nodes.desc: L89: blanket impls generated by factory_tuple! let any async fn of N extractor args become a route.

nodes.label: Responder
nodes.desc: L39: respond_to() converts handler output - &str, Json, Result<T, E>, impl Responder - into an HttpResponse.

nodes.label: ServiceResponse
nodes.desc: L417: request parts + response; the type middleware see, transform and pass outward.

nodes.label: FromRequest
nodes.desc: L66: the typed-argument contract; from_request L90 builds Self from &HttpRequest and &mut Payload, extract() L95 skips the body.

nodes.label: web::Path
nodes.desc: L89: FromRequest impl deserializes matched URL segments captured by the ResourceDef pattern.

nodes.label: web::Json
nodes.desc: L139: FromRequest impl awaits the payload to completion, then serde-parses under JsonConfig limits.

nodes.label: web::Data
nodes.desc: L162: FromRequest impl hands handlers an Arc clone of state built by App::data factories once per worker.

nodes.label: middleware::from_fn
nodes.desc: L84: wraps an async fn(ServiceRequest, Next) into a Transform; Next (L223) invokes the wrapped service. App::wrap (app.rs L345) stacks them.

nodes.label: rt module
nodes.desc: L78: actix-rt re-exports (System, Runtime, spawn); each worker thread owns a single-threaded tokio runtime and LocalSet.
